_comment: Public methods consumers actually call, by component tag. IGDS does not mark internal methods private (the manifest lists ~600 'public' methods, 3 documented), so this list is curated. Signatures come from data/igds-manifest.json; a method listed here but missing from the manifest is skipped with a build warning. Each entry was checked against the @igds/core-web 0.1.37 typings.

methods.show: Display the toast. Required for type="floating": a floating toast stays hidden (display: none) until show() is called; there is no `open` prop. Moves the element into a shared toast container.
methods.close: Animate the toast out, move it back to its original parent, then emit igds-close.

methods.requestClose: Close the modal as if the user dismissed it (sets open = false). Prefer controlling the `open` prop.

methods.focus: Move focus to the inner native button.

methods.checkValidity: Run constraint validation without showing UI; returns whether the value is valid.
methods.reportValidity: Run constraint validation and show the validation message if invalid.

methods.stop: Stop recording; emits igds-stop with the recording details.

methods.openItem: Expand the item with this id.
methods.closeItem: Collapse the item with this id.
methods.toggleItem: Toggle the item with this id.

methods.focusCellByAddress: Move keyboard focus to a cell (requires `focusable`).
